description: Two And/Or pairs, two inverters and a five-input Or, every one of them reading a voltage above 0V as true

inputs.text: One of the two inputs that section's And and Or outputs both read
The input that inverter turns over
One of the five inputs of the five-way Or

outputs.text: Carries 10V while both inputs of that section read above 0V, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while either input of that section reads above 0V, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while its input reads 0V or below, and 0V while its input is above 0V
Carries 10V while any of the five inputs reads above 0V, and 0V otherwise

notes: an unpatched jack reads 0V, which counts as low, so both inverter outputs carry 10V from the moment the module is placed
